# Brand Identity Design

1. Treat ClipYantra as a proposed brand name until domain/trademark review is complete.
2. Translate product positioning into personality attributes: intelligent, capable, creative, calm and trustworthy.
3. Propose at least two meaningfully different visual directions when direction is unapproved.
4. Show how each direction applies to dashboard, Clip Studio, status states and app icon.
5. Recommend an identity system that works in monochrome, small sizes, light/dark surfaces and export watermark contexts.
6. Avoid generic magic-wand, scissors or play-button clichés unless made distinctive.
7. Explain typography, color, shape, icon and motion rationale.
8. Do not present generated concept art as final vector assets or finished production logo.
9. Record alternatives, trade-offs, rights checks and explicit approval request.
